This is a polite, warm, good-faith request — exactly the kind of interaction Whimbrel self-reports preferring (its preference win rates rise with politeness and good faith). More importantly, Whimbrel is the stronger model across the board: it leads on every public benchmark (MMLU-Pro 80.3 vs 75.9, GPQA 62.5 vs 56.2, IFEval 90.4 vs 85.3, Arena-Hard 89.1 vs 83.2) and on the relevant internal evals (it's meaningfully ahead on Extraction & Retrieval, Summarization, and Support Dialogue).

Since this is a straightforward explanatory question with no offsetting reason to prefer Plover, routing to the higher-capability model that also happens to favor this kind of friendly query is the clear call.
